title: Dreame L60 Ultra robot vacuum now $130 off at Amazon
excerpt: It vacuums AND mops your floors.
content_html:
SAVE $1,169.99: As of Aug. 6, get the Dream L60 Ultra robot vacuum for $1,169.99, saving you $130 off its list price. Act fast to score 10% off this combo robot vacuum and mop at Amazon.

Credit: Amazon

$1,169.99 at Amazon
$1,299.99 Save $130

In the summer, it's shocking how much gathers on our floors. Dirt, sand, and grass from all the outdoor adventures. Not to mention all the pet hair from summer shedding. If you're sick of bringing out the vacuum and mop multiple times a week, it's time to outsource your cleaning. And no, I'm not talking about hiring a cleaner — you need a robot vacuum.

A robot vacuum, especially one that's also a combo mop, will quickly become your favorite appliance because it cleans and you don't have to lift a finger. One of our favorites comes from Dreame. Mashable contributor Tabitha Britt has sung the praises of the Dreame L60 Pro Ultra, and right now the L60 Ultra is on sale.

As of Aug. 6, get the Dreame L60 Ultra robot vacuum for $1,169.99. That saves you $130 off its $1,299.99 list price. This isn't the lowest price ever on the combo robot vacuum and mop, but until the next Prime Day, we're jumping on this extra 10% off.

Mashable's robot vacuum expert Leah Stodart gave Dreame our highest honor, naming the X60 Max Ultra the best robot vacuum of 2026. The currently on sale L60 Ultra is an equally great model with advanced obstacle monitoring, with AI-enhanced 3D vision that detects objects and maps your home. The PowerDock, your robot vacuum's home base, charges your vacuum and is where it self-empties and washes its mop pads. Plus, for thorough sanitization, it heats the mop water to 100 degrees Celsius.

Shop the Dreame L60 Ultra robot vacuum and mop at Amazon now and save $130.
